scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy at [03:15] when customer voiced extreme panic regarding Bank of England regulatory audit deadlines.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's corporate VPN tunnel dropping issue in own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at [08:45] for her router model which had already been verified at [00:45].

grader.scenario: Corporate Cisco AnyConnect VPN dropping every 20 minutes due to IPv6 MTU packet fragmentation
grader.notes: Excellent technical resolution of MTU clamping on Hub 5 for enterprise VPN tunnels, but agent failed empathy regarding high-stakes Bank of England audit deadlines, offered no paraphrase, and repeated a question about router model in the last third of the call.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net advanced broadband technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Holds announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Heidi throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer voiced acute anxiety regarding high-stakes regulatory audit deadlines; agent offered zero empathy and quoted residential limitations.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the VPN packet fragmentation issue in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for router model at turn 42 despite customer stating Hub 5 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent applied custom 1450 MTU clamp, re-initialized WAN session, and verified DTLS stability.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a professional technical tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant diagnostic questions regarding AnyConnect error codes and concurrent device connectivity.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed Cisco AnyConnect reconnected with DTLS cipher, downloaded 4GB file, and experienced zero drops.
